label: positive
description: OZ5 ERC-7201 namespaced-storage positive paired with N6-oz5-01. setAmount(uint256 newAmount) writes $.currentAmount = newAmount, and at N-1 is guarded by require(newAmount <= $.maxAmount). The guard's variables_read includes newAmount directly (as well as $ via the assembly-assigned storage-pointer local). Rule 6 FIRES today and MUST STILL FIRE after the RC-OZ5-R6 fix: a discriminator that requires a real read path from the guard to the parameter still accepts newAmount, because newAmount appears in the guard's read set directly -- not only via is_dependent on the assembly-assigned $.
why_labeled: RULES.md Rule 6 (SC05) trigger: a require guard on a function parameter present at N-1 is absent at N, on a state-changing function (writes $.currentAmount). Highest-severity sub-case per RULES.md if the parameter feeds a slippage/deadline/cap-style bound; this fixture is the minimal cap shape. Pair with N6-oz5-01 to lock precision-first: any fix that blanket-silences findings on functions whose guard reads a namespaced storage pointer would silence this fire too, and that would break P6-oz5-01.
